_comment: Английский путеводитель (меню «Пути»): переводы hint и forks из scenes/_guides.json. Ключи и порядок — как в русском; secret/gate берутся из русского. Правишь русский — правь и здесь.

Ф-01.hint: Anyone who made it to the willows at Black Backwater. This road is always open.
forks: Reach the willows in '96.
Go back nowhere.

Ф-02.hint: Someone who didn't bend fate to suit himself too often: the world around has barely slid. And for someone to be waiting for you at home in the end, you need a person close to you and real closeness.
forks: In "School No. 41" (2016), don't stay alone.
In "The Pull" (2061), bring the one beside you to the shore.
In the willows, go back to where someone is waiting.

Ф-03.hint: Anyone. All it takes is the courage to do nothing.
forks: At Black Backwater in 2061, don't dive. Stay on the shore and watch.

Ф-04.hint: Resonance almost "choirmaster," and the world around has barely slid. You must know Lunyov's whole truth and close the loop exactly the way it once opened.
forks: In "Forty-Two" (2016), read Lunyov's letter.
By the snag in '96, do for the boy the same thing he heard in "Four Minutes."
In the willows, stay in '96 as one of your own, and at dawn walk up to the man without a fishing rod.

Ф-05.hint: Resonance "choirmaster," Heart "attuned" or higher. And you must have gone under the electrodes: "The Protocol" or "The Standard."
forks: Listen to the water and the chill at the back of your neck at every chance.
In "The Protocol" (2014), agree.
Don't shut yourself off from people: teach, tell the truth, listen.
In the willows, open the Choir to everyone.

Ф-06.hint: Resonance "choirmaster," and you went through the standard session: Granddad's experiment worked on you. This road is only for the one who became "the Oracle."
forks: In "Twelve Minutes" (2016), the session has to become the standard.
At the institute, listen to the end.
In the willows, stay in the loop.

⊣К-02.hint: Dead end. Body "frail" or "ordinary" by fifty-six: someone who breathed coal dust for thirty-six years and didn't look after himself.
forks: After graduation, go "Like Dad," to the Glubokaya.
In "Methane" (2010), lie on the ground under the wet jacket and don't join the mine rescue.
In "Black Lungs" (2045), don't leave for Tanya.

⊣К-03.hint: Dead end. Someone tired of running from what they made of him.
forks: In "The Antenna" (2028), agree to become an instrument.

⊣К-07.hint: Dead end. Someone who left for "anywhere, as long as it's away from here" and never wanted to come back. Will has to be at least "stubborn" to leave.
forks: After graduation, go anywhere, as long as it's away from here.
In "The Voice Message" (2055), don't answer Sonka.

⊣К-08.hint: Dead end. Someone whose voices rang louder than other people's since childhood, Resonance at least "a chill," and who in the end chose silence.
forks: After graduation, follow the voices that got louder than people.
In "Sonka" (2012), stay on as an orderly with Anna Markovna and take the pills.

⊣К-06.hint: Dead end. Someone who sold his deaths twice: at the gambling table and at Shadrin's meetings. The world drifts away from a man like that, to where he isn't.
forks: After graduation, go to Welder: "Need money? I've got work."
In "The Drum" (2012), spin once more, knowing who will get up from the table.
In "The Sapper" (2019), tell Shadrin who is standing in the kitchen.
In "Left-Hand Traffic" (2049), get on the bus to Shcheglovsk.

⊣К-04.hint: Dead end. Someone who went where it's quiet and cold, and found what he was looking for there: silence.
forks: After graduation, sign on as a laborer with a geological survey party.
In "Strangers in the Ringing" (2047), stay on the island for good.

Ф-07.hint: Someone who took what was his all his life: the world around has slid far, or the will is iron and the pity is thin.
forks: In the willows, stay in '96 with what you know is coming.
In '98, don't let the blood from '96 slip away.
When the eighteen-year-old comes to the market looking for work, take him on.

Ф-08.hint: The wolf who got to the vials before Orpheus. The darkest ending.
forks: In the willows, stay in '96 as a wolf.
On the seventeenth of August, '98, buy the blood out from under Lunyov's buyers or hand it to Shadrin.
When he comes to the market, ask him to roll up his sleeve.

Ф-09.hint: The wolf who let his prey go.
forks: In the willows, stay in '96 as a wolf.
When the eighteen-year-old comes to the market, send him off to Tomsk. And if the blood has been destroyed, tell him the truth.

Ф-10.hint: Go home when someone is waiting for you on the shore, and keep one thread of the gift.
forks: The world has barely slid: in the willows, go back to '61.
Someone has to be waiting for you on the shore in 2061.
When the Choir leaves, keep the last thread for yourself.

Ф-11.hint: The one who hears: the gift is loud, the seam holds.
forks: In the willows, don't leave the seam.
Go in to them and become one of the voices.

Ф-12.hint: Someone who lived for people and didn't drift away from himself.
forks: In the willows, stay in '96, close to your own.
What to tell your young father by the kiosk is up to you.
At dawn, leave the man without a fishing rod alone, or simply ask him.

Ф-13.hint: Stay one of your own and know who Lunyov is looking for at the backwater.
forks: Learn the truth about Mitya (Lunyov's confession, the voices, or his letter).
In the willows, stay in '96, close to your own.
At dawn, tell the man without a fishing rod only one thing: where Mitya lies.

⊣К-13.hint: A wolf with no muscle behind him.
forks: In '98, walk into room three hundred twelve alone.

⊣К-14.hint: One word too many through the bushes.
forks: Back home, say one word to the boy in the willows.

⊣К-15.hint: A father who can hear himself coming back and can't stop saving his own.
forks: In "Twelve Sensors" (2033), drive out at night to Varya's highway.
Die there three times and write out her road for her minute by minute.
Two years later, don't take the map down from the wall.
